work.text: In this first attempt to present the story of Judith, Artemisia creates a composition (an inverted triangle) that underlines the struggle of the three protagonists and offers the immediacy of an observed event.

matters.text: During the trial, Gentileschi was tortured with a "sibille", cords wrapped around the fingers and pulled tight (similar to thumbscrews), for the purpose of verifying her testimony (a common practice at the time). As the cords tighten, she is recorded as turning to Tassi and saying: "This is the ring that you give me and these are your promises."
matters.lead: The painting dates from the year of the 1612 trial of Agostino Tassi for her rape:

matters.text: The law gauged damage to economic and social assets rather than suffering and psychological trauma.
